warnings: Axes: x = 1, 2 (3.60); y = Thai rows printed top-to-bottom ค, ข, ก. Origin ค1.

Span conflict: the upper floor plan and the roof plan print 3.00 + 3.60 for ค–ข–ก, but every sheet prints the overall as 6.00 and the footing plan prints 3.00 + 3.00. Two sheets' 3.60 against three totals plus one detail row: ข is placed at 3.00 (ก at 6.00) and the 3.60 rows are kept verbatim in dimension_chains (they do not close).
Only the two structural sheets were dimension-swept; the architectural elevations/sections (pages 6-11) were not read, so z_levels holds only the +0.00 printed on the S sheet.
